name: mysql-mcp-server
description: Secure MySQL access for AI assistants: list tables, inspect schemas, sample data, and execute SQL with read/write account separation and two-step confirmation for writes.
long_description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for MySQL. AI assistants can discover tables, inspect column metadata, sample rows, and run ad-hoc SQL. Reads use a read-only account; writes and deletes require explicit user confirmation (server popup or chat-based token flow, with a 6-second cooling period). Failed executions are recorded to a local error log. Multi-database aliases, SSH tunnels, and Dameng DM8 are supported via the config file; bundle mode configures a single database through the install UI.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Execute a SQL statement (SELECT, DML, SHOW, DESCRIBE). Single statements only; use database.table notation. Writes/deletes need user confirmation: either a prompt appears, or the first call returns a confirm_token to re-call with after explicit user consent.

tools.name: get_schema_info
tools.description: Get column metadata for a table or all tables: names, types, nullability, defaults, comments. Accepts database.table notation.

tools.name: get_table_sample
tools.description: Fetch a small sample of rows from a table (default 5, max 20). Accepts database.table notation.

mysql_database.title: MySQL Database
mysql_database.description: Database to connect to. Leave empty for multi-database mode.

mysql_allow_delete.title: Allow DELETE / DROP
mysql_allow_delete.description: Permit DELETE, TRUNCATE and DROP statements (still require per-statement confirmation). Data loss cannot be undone.
